name: Center Laboratories, Inc.
summary: Center Laboratories, Inc., a pharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceuticals in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers general medication pharmaceuticals comprising antipyretic analgesics, bronchodilators, anti-inflammatory preparations, antihistamines, expectorants, narcotic antitussives and expectorants, gastrointestinal preparations, non-narcotic antitussives and expectorants, and other medicines. It also provides central nervous system medication consisting of treatments for cerebrovascular disease, dementia, depression, schizophrenia, epilepsy, and Parkinson's disease. Center Laboratories, Inc. was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
